text.autoconfig.simplequalityoflife.opti: Frost Walker Walk on Powder Snow

Allows players wearing Frost Walker boots to
walk on powder snow without sinking. Default:
true.
Quality of Life
Enable Auto-Walk

Allows automatic walking via keybind.
Default: false.
Ladder Climbing Speed

Adjusts the vertical speed when climbing
ladders. Vanilla default is ~0.2. Default:
0.4. Allowed range: 0.2–0.4.
Fast Ladder Slide

If enabled, allows faster sliding down
ladders. Default: true.
Ladder Slide Speed

Adjusts the vertical speed when sliding down
ladders. Default: 0.8. Allowed range:
0.15–0.8.
Slide Activation Mode

Determines how ladder sliding is activated
(CAMERA = look down + sneak, ALWAYS = look
down unless sneaking). Default: "CAMERA".
Enable Simple Weather

Bundled sub-mod: weather switch and rain
density, settings in Simple Weather's own
config. Default: true.
Enable Simple Interfaces

Bundled sub-mod: the Simple style for
Vanilla container screens, settings in
Simple Interfaces' own config. Default: true.
Enable Simple Tools

Bundled sub-mod: full-durability bonus,
Thrift, anvil repair cost and furnace lava
fill, settings in Simple Tools's own
config. Default: true.
Enable Simple Farming

Bundled sub-mod: farmland protection,
grass cutting and hoe harvesting, settings
in Simple Farming's own config. Default:
true.
Enable Simple Creatures

Bundled sub-mod: muted mobs, named babies
and gold-tolerant piglins, settings in
Simple Creatures's own config. Default:
true.
Enable Simple Loot

Bundled sub-mod: repeat vault rewards
after a cooldown, settings in Simple
Loot's own config. Default: true.
simplequalityoflife.config.title: Simple Quality of Life — Server settings
text.autoconfig.simplequalityoflife.opti: Manual Crawling

Allow /crawl and the crawl key. The server
validates and limits changes. Default: true.
Linked Containers

Sneak + right-click a container with an empty
hand to mark it. The next chest or GUI you open
shows the marked container above it with a
shared inventory. Sneak + right-click it again
to unmark. Default: true.
Linked Container Range

Blocks between player and marked container.
Farther away, another dimension or an
unloaded chunk ends the mark. Default: 64.
Allowed range: 8–128.
Easy Shulker Boxes

Right-click a shulker box in the air or on its
inventory slot to open it without placing it.
The box stays locked in its slot while open.
Default: true.
Easy Ender Chests

Right-click an ender chest in the air or on its
inventory slot to open your ender chest
without placing it. Default: true.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.1.title: Simple Quality of Life
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.1: Server-controlled movement, farming, mob, weather and vault utilities.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.2.title: Manual crawling
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.2: P or /crawl sets the synchronized swimming pose. Jump exits. Commands are limited to one change per 10 ticks; spectators and passengers are refused.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.3.title: Auto-walk
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.3: R toggles ordinary forward input only when the server enables qOL.enableAutowalk (default false). Opening a screen or leaving the world stops it. A click sound signals the change. It adds no speed or reach.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.4.title: Climbing and sliding
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.4: Climbing speed defaults to 0.4 blocks/tick (range 0.2–0.4). Slide speed defaults to 0.8 (range 0.15–0.8). CAMERA requires looking down and sneaking; ALWAYS requires looking down without sneaking.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.5.title: Climbing and sliding
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.5: The server rejects excess vertical movement on climbable blocks with a bounded latency allowance.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.6.title: Frost Walker on powder snow
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.6: Frost Walker permits walking on powder snow. Enabled by frostWalkerWalkOnPowderSnow, default true.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.7.title: Weather controls (Simple Weather)
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.7: Moved into the bundled sub-mod Simple Weather (simpleweather): disableWeather (default false) clears rain and thunder; clientRainParticleDensity (default 20, 0–100) is a local visual preference.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.8.title: Weather controls (Simple Weather)
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.8: Old settings are taken over once; "Enable Simple Weather" switches it off.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.9.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.9: /crawl is available to players. Owner-level /simplequalityoflife offers tweaks autowalk, frostWalkerSnow, ladderSpeed. Changes are saved to config/simplequalityoflife.json.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.10.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.10: Sneak + right-click a container with an empty main hand to mark it (a double chest counts as one); dust particles at your hand show the mark.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.11.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.11: The next chest or GUI you open (crafting table, furnace, anvil …) shows the marked container above it,
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.12.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.12: sharing your inventory. Shift-click moves marked → second GUI, else inventory; inventory → second GUI, else the marked container.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.13.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.13: The mark ends beyond qOL.linkedContainerRange (default 64, range 8–128), in another dimension, in an unloaded chunk, when the block is gone, on logout or death, or with another sneak + right-click on it.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.14.title: Linked containers
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.14: Claims and locks are checked. The recipe book still only counts your inventory.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.15.title: Easy shulker boxes and ender chests
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.15: Right-click a shulker box (any color, also SimpleBuilding tier boxes) or an ender chest in the air, or right-click it on its own inventory slot, to open it without placing it.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.16.title: Easy shulker boxes and ender chests
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.16: The item stays locked in its slot while open; every change is written into the box at once. Shulker boxes do not fit inside. Not from the creative inventory tab. Switches:
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.17.title: Easy shulker boxes and ender chests
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.18.title: Vault cooldown
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.18: A player may loot a vault again after vaultCooldownDays, default 100 Minecraft days, bounded 1–36500. The original SimpleBuildingLootTimes UUID-to-time map is retained.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.19.title: Vault cooldown
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.19: Missing timestamps on already rewarded entries start a cooldown rather than granting free repeat loot; backwards time does not unlock rewards.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.20.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.20: Owner-level /simpleloot vaults cooldown <days> and /simpleloot vaults repeat <true|false>; changes are saved to config/simpleloot.json.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.21.title: Mute mobs
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.21: mutedEntities selects entity IDs. Names ending in _mute or _shhh are silent by default. Lists accept at most 64 nonempty distinct entries of at most 64 characters. Existing Vanilla silent state remains effective.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.22.title: Permanent babies
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.22: Every 100 ticks, named ageable mobs ending in _baby or _small are set to age -24000. The source also makes named adults young again; this behavior is preserved. Removing the suffix allows aging again.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.23.title: Piglin gold equipment
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.23: Gold armor trims or a golden sword, spear, pickaxe, axe, shovel, or hoe in either hand count as
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.24.title: Piglin gold equipment
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.24: safe equipment. The two switches default true. This does not prevent anger caused by attacking or opening containers.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.25.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.25: Owner-level /simplecreatures muteSuffixes, babySuffixes and mutedEntities list/add/remove/clear; piglinsIgnoreGoldTrims and piglinsIgnoreGoldTools <true|false>.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.26.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.27.title: Feather Falling farmland protection
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.27: Feather Falling boots prevent trampling. This complements SimpleBuilding Breeze head protection. Enabled by preventFarmlandTrampleWithFeatherFalling, default true.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.28.title: Hoe harvest and replant
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.28: Main-hand hoes harvest mature wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, and cocoa. One seed is taken from the actual loot; survival costs one durability.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.29.title: Hoe harvest and replant
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.29: Server reach, world border, spawn protection, build rights, loader break vetoes, and a four-tick action limit are enforced.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.30.title: Sharpness cuts vegetation
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.30: Sharpness III or higher on a sword or axe clears explicit small vegetation overlapping the attacked entity. Sneaking disables it. At most 27 positions within 4.5 blocks are considered;
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.31.title: Sharpness cuts vegetation
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.31: loader break vetoes and action cooldown apply. The matching vegetation outline is hidden.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.32.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.32: Owner-level /simplefarming farmlandProtect, hoeHarvest and sharpnessCut <true|false>; changes are saved to config/simplefarming.json.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.33.title: Furnace lava fill
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.33: Either hand inserts one lava bucket into a furnace, blast furnace, or smoker with an empty fuel slot or one leftover empty bucket. Locked furnaces and sneaking are excluded. Survival consumes the lava bucket;
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.34.title: Furnace lava fill
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.34: an existing empty bucket is returned exactly once. SimpleBuilding furnace subclasses are supported through the Vanilla interface.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.35.title: Durability bonus
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.35: Damageable held Vanilla and mod tools above the durability threshold can gain attack damage and mining speed. The default multiplier is 1.0 (no bonus), with a server-enforced range of 1–1.5. The threshold defaults to 80% (range 80–100%).
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.36.title: Durability bonus
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.37.title: Thrift
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.37: Enchantment for every item with durability, levels I-III: +1/3 maximum durability per level, level III doubles it. Not combinable with Mending; Unbreaking still works.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.38.title: Thrift
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.38: Anvil repair with material restores a quarter of the (larger) maximum per item, so the same number of items as without the enchantment repairs it fully.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.39.title: Thrift
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.39: Enchanting table, trades and loot like other non-treasure enchantments. The id stays simplequalityoflife:thrift, so
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.40.title: Thrift
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.40: enchanted items from older worlds keep it; it also works with the sub-mod switched off.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.41.title: Repairing keeps the anvil cost
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.41: Repairing with material, combining two items without new enchantments or renaming keeps the higher anvil cost of the inputs instead of raising it. Only a change of enchantments raises it like vanilla.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.42.title: Repairing keeps the anvil cost
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.43.title: Commands
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.43: Owner-level /simpletools fullDurabilityBonus, anvilRepairKeepsCost and furnaceLava <true|false>; changes are saved to config/simpletools.json.
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.44.title: Settings
simplequalityoflife.guide.page.44: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
quests.simplequalityoflife.start.title: Welcome to Simple Quality of Life
quests.simplequalityoflife.start.welcome: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Quality of Life Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a chest.
